BattleAction field names and the max_hp/max_pp/hp/pp/poison vocabulary are inherited only where exact local layouts coincide; the unresolved early BattleUnit fields remain in an owner-local view.

The retained lookup branch reduced the 564-halfword baseline to 557; the damage-class branch and indexed stat access reduced it to 539; direct raw-field access in the two follow-up cases then reduced it to 487.

Removing the primary HP raw carriers was linked-score neutral at 539 but removed two wrong instructions and enabled the later follow-up lifetime improvements; primary PP deliberately retains its carriers because removing them re-enters the 581-halfword allocation family.
No inline assembly, fixed-register variables, compiler barriers, copied instruction bytes, compiler changes, or nonlocal evidence were used.
This is a measured draft only; retained reference assembly remains authoritative.
